VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 21, 2026
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Kenneth Osborn, Chair  James Goodin, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Vice Chair  Hershell Hardimon, Commissioner
Jerry Earl, Commissioner  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO GINA.OVERHOLT@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54056  Recommendation to receive and file opening remarks from the Chair.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54055  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Veterans Affairs Commission
  meeting of Wednesday, December 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54057  Recommendation to receive and file a report on the activities of the Office of
  Veterans Support.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54058  Recommendation to discuss moving Veterans Affairs Commission regular
  meetings to a new date.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54059  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the 2025 Veterans Banner
  Program Ad Hoc Committee and to take action to dissolve the committee if
  appropriate.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 21, 2026
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

6.  26-54061  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the 2026 Veterans Banner
  Program Ad Hoc Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54060  Recommendation to discuss the 2026 Memorial Day event and take action to
  create an ad hoc committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-54063  Recommendation to create an ad hoc committee on H.R. 5945, a bill that will
  honor the USS Frank E. Evans’ Lost 74 by having their names memorialized on
  the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in Washington, D.C.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Veterans Affairs Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Gina Overholt, Veterans Affairs Commission Coordinator, certify that the agenda was posted not
less than 24 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Gina Overholt at (562) 570-4035 or
gina.overholt@longbeach.gov.
